entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Immamzadeh Mahruq is an Immamzadeh/mosque and the resting place of Imamzadeh Muhammad Mahruq ibn Muhammad ibn Zayd ibn Ali and Imamzadeh Ibrahim ibn Ahmad ibn Musa al-Kazim situated in Omar Khayyam and Immamzadeh Mohammad Mahruq Garden in Nishapur, Khorasan Province, northeastern Iran. According to Iranarchpedia the building and the mosque of the Immamzadeh date back to the Timurid and the Safavid eras. This mosque is now registered as part of the Iranian national heritage list with the registration number of 302.
